title: AAD oversize returns BUFFER_E, not a silent skip
description: Lines 709-712: authInSz > CRYPTO2DEV_AAD_MAXLEN returns BUFFER_E rather than truncating or skipping AAD. Truncating/skipping would authenticate with different AAD than the caller provided. BUFFER_E is the correct signal. This is the correct pattern; see P0 finding wolfssl-0t2.1 for the corresponding gap in the decrypt tag path.
